title: John Mack at Harvard, his friend Bud Hopkins and Thomas Kuhn's advice
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Mack at Harvard, his friend Bud Hopkins and Thomas Kuhn's advice, about 1990s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: John Mack was the head of the Harvard psychiatry department in the '9s. and he was actually childhood friends with a guy named Bud Hopkins

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1990s John Mack was the head of the psychiatry department at Harvard University. According to Michels, Mack had been childhood friends with a man named Bud Hopkins, and the story also involves advice Mack got from Thomas Kuhn, a well-known thinker about how science changes. Michels tells it to show how a senior Harvard psychiatrist came to take stories of alien encounters seriously.
